event.title: Highest temperature in Munich on August 3?
event.description:
This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Munich Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 3 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Munich Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/de/munich/EDDM.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Official temperature observations from Munich stations have confirmed a daily maximum of 36°C on August 3, 2026, aligning with the market's 100% implied probability for that exact outcome. This reading exceeds the city's long-term August average high of roughly 23–25°C by a substantial margin, driven by a persistent high-pressure system promoting clear skies, subsidence warming, and minimal cloud cover or precipitation. German meteorological data, consistent with broader European heat patterns, support the result. Realistic challenges remain limited but could include post hoc adjustments to the official record from the Deutscher Wetterdienst, differences across urban versus airport measurement sites, or rare instrument calibration issues, though historical precedent shows such revisions are infrequent once preliminary maxima are validated.
